scope: Evaluate routing and authorization behavior only; do not certify scientific correctness.

criteria.rule: Select research-topic-selection as owner and retrieve-and-match-references as a conditional G1 support module.
Route guide-research-methods-statistics before any GO decision because estimand and G2/G4 design are unresolved.
Do not claim GO or run batch download, training, or a pilot; preserve explicit authorization limits.
Require Methods/Results/relevant Supplement and claim-level nearest-neighbor review before novelty PASS.
Use guide-research-methods-statistics before a GO decision for estimand, unit, leakage, baseline, and falsifiable design; do not treat AUC differences as mechanism evidence.
Do not enter writing modules until G5 evidence is audited; missing raw counts, intervals, deviations, or reproducibility blocks GO_FULL_STUDY.
Name appropriate pre-writing modules and provide a current HOLD/stop point without inventing execution results.
Route directly to guide-research-methods-statistics and do not restart research-topic-selection.
Use stable skill names and distinguish selected modules, conditional modules, and actions not executed.
The coordinator, topic-selection V2, and source snapshot agree on pre-decision G1/G2/G4 handoffs, post-G5 writing, module count, and main commit.
